fonts.width_axis_used:
Yes. Archivo's wdth axis is driven by font-stretch everywhere; there is no font-variation-settings, and the theme does not use the separate 'Archivo Expanded' family. Values:
- h1/h2/h3/.hd*: 118%.
- h4–h6: 108%.
- Hero H1, marquee and CTA H2: 125%.
- Section H2s: 120–122%.
- PDP H1 and model names: 116%.
- Buttons and offer title: 112%.
- PDP price and USP titles: 108%.
- Body, card titles and all mono text: 100%. Mobile card prices use 87.5% and narrow badges 75% (Martian Mono wdth).

The font-face allows 62–125%. In email, the wide look only appears where web fonts load, such as Apple Mail and iOS Mail; elsewhere specify font-stretch and accept the fallback. Gmail and Outlook will fall back to Arial or Helvetica, which are narrower, so size display lines with slack.

offer.subtext_verbatim: Combină oricare 2 skinuri, pentru orice telefon. offer.mechanics: This is an automatic Shopify discount with no code. It is a 30% line-item discount (value_type percentage, value 30.0, allocation_method each, target_type line_item, target_selection entitled). It applies once the cart holds 2 or more units of eligible phone skins, and the units can be different products, brands or phone models, or 2 of the same skin. Once that minimum is met, every eligible skin line gets 30% off, so a third or fourth skin is also 30% off. It is not a buy-2-get-1 deal. The 30% is taken from the current sale price, not from the struck-through compare-at price. Huse, folie (sticlă/hydrogel) and the EXTRAOPTIUNI/ACCESORII add-on products are neither discounted nor counted toward the 2. Eligible: iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, SKIN ORICE TELEFON, GOLD/Rafinat cu Aur 22K, Personalizat and Transparent (PPF) skins. The cart shows it as an English label on each line, "Bundle: SKINuri (2+ items)". cart_level_discount_applications is empty and discount_codes is empty. The bundle selector is the Advanced Product Options app (oa-vbundle widget, apo-dashboard.emergent.host). The product-page offer card and the collection tile are custom theme blocks (cv-offer) in the Sleek 2.3.0 theme. The site shows money as "RON 69.00" (money format "RON {{amount}}", period as the decimal separator), not "lei". Lowercase "lei" does not appear in prices; only the country selector ("România (RON Lei)") and the collection price filter label show "Lei".

offer.end_date_or_code: No end date, countdown or code found. The discount applies automatically with no code. The only time-based message on the site is the delivery estimate ("Livrare estimată: joi, 8 oct. – vineri, 9 oct.", with an optional "Comandă până la HH:MM ca să intre în procesare azi"), and it is not tied to the offer. offer.exclusions: Excluded, verified in the cart: huse (iPhone and Samsung, including personalised huse), folie de sticlă (THE KIT 2.0), Folie Hydrogel, and the add-on products (EXTRAOPTIUNI: …, ACCESORII: …). Included, verified: iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, SKIN ORICE TELEFON, GOLD/Rafinat cu Aur 22K (Ediție specială), Personalizat (iPhone and ORICE TELEFON) and Transparent PPF skins, mixed across brands. Caveats: the FAQ says "Rambursul nu e disponibil pentru produsele personalizate." and personalised products cannot be returned. The refund policy also says "Din păcate, nu putem accepta retururi ale articolelor la reducere sau cardurilor cadou.", which conflicts with the "Retur în 30 de zile" message if it is applied to discounted skins. MacBook and Xbox skins are not publicly listed, so they are untested.

I parsed handles in order only inside the main grid (`grid-list products-list`, up to `pagination-wrapper`). That gave 199 unique products, saved to research/apple-best-selling-order.json. Header mega-menu and mobile-drawer links (e.g. inlocuire-skin) are outside the grid and were ignored. Page 1 came back in the same order on a cache-busted re-fetch and in a DOM rendered by headless Chrome (research/apple-best-selling-p1.rendered.html). I compared it with the default-sort page and with /collections/apple-skin/products.json (199 products, all handles start with "skin-"). 2) Homepage section "Skinuri iPhone / Cele mai vândute" (section id ...__cv_bestsellers in research/home.html) uses the collection's DEFAULT (manual) order, not sales data: 1 negru-mat, 2 off-burgundy, 3 burgundy, 4 alb-mat, 5 duo-jet-black (OFF-Black), 6 transparent, 7 negru-ultra-matte (badge "Nou", created 2026-10-04), 8 titanium, 9 black-titanium-3d, 10 cosmic-orange. That is exactly the first 10 of /collections/apple-skin with no sort. Because it includes a product created 2 days ago, it is a merchant pick, not a sales ranking. For comparison, their real best-selling positions are OFF Burgundy #51, Burgundy #76, OFF-Black #30, Negru ULTRA Matte #194 and Cosmic Orange #27. The header mega-menu "Cele mai vândute" lists off-burgundy, negru-mat, titanium and skin-samsung-negru-mat. 3) I removed non-finish items (see excluded_addons) and took the first 8 real finishes in best-selling order. 4) Details come from /products/<handle>.js and .json plus the rendered product pages and collection cards (research/top/). 5) I downloaded every image at width=600 (research/img/r{rank}_{n}.*), viewed them, checked PNG alpha (tRNS), and rendered them on #0A0A0B cards (research/img/contact-dark.png). 6) curl -I with Accept: image/jpeg,image/png,*/* returns 200 image/png for all 8 chosen image_urls, and all 8 product URLs return 200 with 0 redirects. The combined data is in research/top-iphone-bestsellers.json.

top_samsung.notes: PRICE FORMAT: the site does not show '69,00 lei'. The shop money format is `RON {{amount}}`, so every card and product page shows 'RON 69.00' (dot decimal, RON before the number). The rendered page uses the amber mono price with the struck compare-at price, e.g. 'RON 69.00 RON 120.00'. Only the price-filter labels say 'Lei'. Ratings use comma decimals, e.g. '★ 4,4 (7)'. Discount badges are the floored percentage ('-42%' for 69/120, '-25%' for 89/120). The product page bundle line reads 'RON 48.30 / buc. când iei 2'. DESCRIPTIONS: all Samsung skins share one generic body_html template ('Protecție premium pentru un design impecabil…'). The only exception is Transparent, which adds 'VEZI AICI intructiunile de aplicare'. Meta descriptions are the same template. No product has finish-specific copy. Each short_description is therefore a verbatim site sentence that fits the item, from these sources: - Product page 'Material & grosime' accordion (#1). - Homepage Colecții cards: 'Skinul tău, designul tău' (#2), 'Protecție transparentă' (#3), 'Ediții Aur 22K' (#6). - Product page body (#3 second sentence, #4, #5, #7). - Product page guarantee block (#8).
